Its key activities involve procuring math kits through Government orders, training teachers to adopt the pedagogy, promoting activity-based learning in the classrooms followed by monitoring and assessments. Building Blocks State Karnataka States Karnataka Is the Foundation’s application to provide access to mathematics learning at home for children from grades 1 to 5. The package is made available in 9 regional languages and has been developed with the help of Cisco. It involves use of modern technologies like web based data analysis and visualisation, mobile applications, interactive voice response systems and conventional data residing on paper to empower a transparent education sector in the state.
